description: Convert an image to JPEG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF. Send base64 or a public URL. Private addresses are refused and the decoded file is capped at 10 MB. Returns the image as base64. HEIC is not decoded here.

file.description: The image. Provide url or data.

data.description: Base64 bytes or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB.

filename.description: File name, including the extension when you have one.

mimeType.description: MIME type when you know it.

url.description: Public http or https URL. Private and local addresses are refused.

name: convert_image
title: Convert an image
